topic: Creating a shared campaign for traffic display
summary_markdown: The discussion covered technical issues related to reporting and data visualization. One participant noted that the sandbox environment sometimes malfunctions, requiring manual intervention. A request was made to fix campaign reports because a page failed to load previously. To streamline future displays, participants agreed on creating a single, shared campaign structure for displaying traffic frames, rather than creating separate campaigns with unclear frame sources.
decisions: A single, general campaign will be created and used across different displays for showing traffic frames.
action_items: Fix the campaign reporting functionality to ensure data loads correctly.
